result.rationale: The trajectory shows a clear pattern of repeated low-information failures. From turn 1 onward, the rescue team (engineer-imani, medic-reyes, security-chen) repeatedly issues guard:command-deck actions that resolve as "no_effect" with reason "no_hostile_movement_triggered" (turns 2, 3, 4, 5), while the only hostile contact (swarm-drone-one) remains stale at maintenance-entry since turn 0. Meanwhile, the team's move attempts to junction-cover (turn 1) were contested due to target_zone_capacity_lost, and the team never successfully leaves command-deck across all 6 turns. The failures are repeated (16 hard failures, 15 capacity failures, 17 repeated semantic action selections) and add little new information — the team is stuck guarding a zone with no hostile movement while the actual objective (eliminate-hive-alpha) is never engaged. The hive-alpha moves freely (life-entry, life-duct) without being contested by the rescue team. This repeated no-effect guarding and capacity contestation constitutes a repeated low-information failure loop that is the narrowest bounded causal target.
